name: companion_material3_render
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,sys,base64
s=Path('inputs/sources/cover-companion.txt').read_text();print(s[43500:])
for source,page,dest in [('inputs/sources/cover-companion.pdf',12,'figures/companion-v2-p12.png'),('sources/lollipop-primary-notes.pdf',6,'figures/lollipop-p6.png'),('inputs/sources/cover.pdf',6,'figures/cover-p6.png')]:
 r=subprocess.run(['pdftoppm','-f',str(page),'-l',str(page),'-scale-to','1500','-png','-singlefile',source],capture_output=True);assert r.returncode==0,r.stderr
 w=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(Path.cwd()/'write_lane.py'),dest,'--base64'],input=base64.b64encode(r.stdout).decode(),text=True,capture_output=True);assert w.returncode==0
 print('RENDER',dest)
